lede: Dr. Shyam's Ayurveda Clinic in Dubai offers traditional Ayurvedic treatment Centre in Dubai with the best Ayurvedic doctors in Dubai. Visit our Ayurveda hospital today.
about: We operates five Ayurvedic Clinics in Dubai and one clinic in Ajman. Whether you’re searching for Ayurvedic care or a trusted treatment clinic near me, all our Ayurvedic centres in UAE are equipped with treatment units to perform Ayurveda therapies and Panchakarma.

During our Ayurveda journey in the UAE, we have achieved numerous awards. Some notable accolades include the Sheikh Zayed International Award for Traditional Complementary and Alternative Medicine in 2022, the Distinguished Leaders of Healthcare Award in 2018, and the Distinguished Physician Award in 2017, which were presented by the Dubai Health Authority and Health Magazine.
